2609.31114.title: From Shortcut Learning to Discrete Neural Insertion Sort
2609.31114.paper_summary: Neural algorithmic reasoning aims to train neural networks to follow known algorithms and generalize beyond the input sizes seen during training. However, correct final outputs and intermediate supervision do not necessarily show that a model follows the intended execution. We study this problem using insertion sort. Our analysis of the CLRS30 baseline NAR shows that the hint objective is weakly optimized and that hint accuracy remains low. Moreover, many intermediate representations can already be decoded into sorted sequences before the reference insertion-sort execution terminates, suggesting that the model learns a shortcut to the final output. Motivated by these findings, we introduce Discrete Neural Insertion Sort. Our model represents the sequence as a chain, separates scalar exchanges from control-state transitions, and projects node representations back to discrete states after every processor step. When trained only on sequences of length 16, the model achieves $100\%$ sorted-sequence accuracy on sequences of length 64 and 128. However, an ablation shows that discretization and graph structure alone are insufficient: without additional supervision of the global inner-loop state, the model fails even at the training length. Our results show that discrete execution can support strong length generalization, while also highlighting the problem-specific inductive bias required to learn a faithful algorithmic execution.
2609.31114.paper_summary_zh: 神經算法推理旨在訓練神經網絡遵循已知算法並超越訓練期間所見的輸入大小進行概括。<lb/>然而，正確的最終輸出和中間監督並不一定顯示模型遵循預期的執行。<lb/>我們使用插入排序來研究這個問題。<lb/>對 CLRS30 基線 NAR 的分析顯示提示目標優化得很弱，並且提示準確性仍然很低。<lb/>此外，許多中間表示在參考插入排序執行終止之前就已經可以解碼為排序序列，這表明模型學會了一條通往最終輸出的捷徑。<lb/>受到這些發現的啟發，我們提出了離散神經插入排序。<lb/>我們的模型將序列表示為一個鏈，將標量交換與控制狀態轉換分開，並在每個處理器步驟後將節點表示投影回離散狀態。<lb/>當僅在長度為 16 的序列上進行訓練時，該模型在長度為 64 和 128 的序列上達到了 $100\%$ 的排序序列準確性。<lb/>然而，一項消融實驗顯示，僅靠離散化和圖結構是不夠的：如果沒有對全局內部循環狀態的額外監督，模型甚至在訓練長度上也會失敗。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，離散執行可以支持強大的長度概括，同時也突顯了學習忠實算法執行所需的問題特定歸納偏差。
